courses.synopsis: Theories of friction between metallic, non-metallic, dry and lubricated surfaces. Testing and properties of materials, solid and liquid lubricants. Theory of self-acting and pressurized bearing, including Reynolds equation and solutions. Dynamic loading, temperature and pressure effects on viscosity. Elastohydrodynamic lubrication, gears and rolling contact bearings. Design of journal and thrust bearings. Application of tribology.
